name: Aim to Capture
source:
A stylish horror visual novel where you take on the role of a spy diving into the memories of others to find dirt on a sinister biocorporation. 

[From [url=https://mysteryjamgames.itch.io/aim-to-capture]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部时尚的恐怖视觉小说，你将扮演一名间谍，深入他人的记忆，寻找邪恶生物公司的污垢。

[来自[url=https://mysteryjamgames.itch.io/aim-to-capture]itch.io[/url]]
